name: Domain Translation to Equivalence Relations
description: Translates the graph-theoretic problem of finding a minimal Steiner tree into an algebraic/systems problem of enforcing state equality through transitive synchronization protocols. This removes all spatial and graph-based affordances (nodes, paths, networks) that trigger the models' tree-pruning heuristics, while preserving the exact same mathematical structure (connected components in a tree). Models that rely on surface pattern matching may incorrectly attempt greedy Kruskal-like approaches and fail to isolate the unique necessary paths.
